title: The Dua of Zakariyya
script: Narrator: [warmly] One night, I read the Quranic account of Prophet Zakariyya, peace be upon him. He asked Allah for a righteous child when he was already old.
Narrator: His situation looked impossible by normal human measures. Still, he called upon Allah with humility and hope.
Narrator: [carefully] What touched me was not a promise that every wish arrives in the exact form we expect. The lesson was about whom we ask and how we ask.
Narrator: [humbly] Prophet Zakariyya knew his weakness and Allah's complete power. His dua was sincere, private, and full of trust.
Narrator: Allah answered him with the good news of Yahya. This answer was a sign of mercy and power beyond ordinary expectation.
Narrator: [reflective] At that time, I was waiting for an answer about a training program. My own matter was small compared with his test.
Narrator: [restless] I had become restless. I checked my email many times each day and imagined that a delay meant the door was closed.
Narrator: [determined] The story reminded me to make dua while also doing what I could. I checked my documents, prepared another application, and continued my work.
Narrator: Trust did not mean sitting without action. It meant acting responsibly without believing that the result was completely in my hands.
Narrator: [disappointed] A week later, the first program rejected me. I felt disappointed, but I did not think my dua had been wasted.
Narrator: The preparation helped me apply to a better program, and that one accepted me a month later.
Narrator: [honestly] I cannot claim to know why every delay happens. I only know that the story corrected my impatient heart.
Narrator: Prophet Zakariyya's dua teaches hope without pride and effort without panic.
Narrator: [hopeful] When a path seems unlikely, a believer continues to ask Allah, takes lawful steps, and accepts that Allah knows the best answer.
